name: tracker-ended-run-disposition
goal: After a Tracker run ends, keep live attempts intact and move the item to a durable retry or a real block. Show Running, Queued or Blocked in Hub.

evidence: Daniel confirmed lifecycle, Hub, and both Macs. Recovery admission currently reports a capacity hold before writing a run; opted-out or blocked work can stay in progress after the run ends.

The existing managed tmux recovery E2E expects zero durable retries while capacity is full, and does not assert the item status after stop. The linked-Mac overview test explicitly expects the legacy no-run label. Strengthen these existing scenarios.
